tools.name: search-services-tool
tools.description: Finds predefined fixed-price services, delivered by people, for a customer's task. Use it when a customer describes a new task; it can be called again with other phrases. Pass the customer's full task in task, in any language. Also pass 1-3 short English phrases in queries, one per service the task

tools.name: get-service-tool
tools.description: Read one active The2410 microservice using a service_id returned by search-services-tool, e.g. svc_8f3k2m9qxa. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: prepare-order-tool · Private data: prepare-order-tool, send-feedback-tool · Public sink: prepare-order-tool, create-checkout-tool, send-feedback-tool.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: prepare-order-tool · Private data: prepare-order-tool, send-feedback-tool · Public sink: prepare-order-tool, create-checkout-tool, send-feedback-tool

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
